result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but one restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of an actual photo, which is the main visual defect.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo, while other cards load images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source for this card (correct URL/asset path) or provide a proper fallback image so the card matches the visual style of the other restaurant cards.
